## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d0ce55e6a2bebe0914f69cedf1207e2d2de13c89`

Rendered by an isolated review subagent spawned by the `domain:ui#4` seat; its served tier was checked against its transcript stamps (89 of 89 at the review tier). Adopted by this seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **(a) Factual sentences vs the installed recharts.** Read from the registry tarball of the release `pnpm-lock.yaml` pins for `recharts` (single lockfile entry; its `integrity` hash equals the tarball's), files `es6/util/DOMUtils.js`, `es6/cartesian/CartesianAxis.js`, `es6/cartesian/getTicks.js`, `es6/cartesian/getEquidistantTicks.js`, `es6/util/TickUtils.js`, `es6/component/Text.js`, `es6/state/selectors/axisSelectors.js`, `es6/cartesian/XAxis.js`, `es6/cartesian/YAxis.js`. Every mechanism claim holds: `SPAN_STYLE` carries no `fontFamily`; the span is created once with `aria-hidden` and `document.body.appendChild`, then reused; `Object.assign(measurementSpan.style, SPAN_STYLE, style)` receives only `{fontSize, letterSpacing}` from `getTickSize`; `getTicks` returns via `getNumberIntervalTicks` before any measurement when `isNumber(interval)`; `tick` is read only in the `!tick` guard; the `layerRef` callback copies `computedStyle.fontSize` and `computedStyle.letterSpacing` into state and nothing else (the only `fontFamily` in the whole `es6/` tree is the `createCacheKey` slot in `DOMUtils.js`); `interval: 'preserveEnd'` is the default in both `implicitXAxis` and `implicitYAxis`, and `XAxis.js`/`YAxis.js` default `interval` to those; `equidistantPreserveEnd` exists (`getEquidistantPreserveEndTicks` branch in `getTicks.js`), so the five non-numeric spellings the page lists are exactly the ones the code branches on; no warning or error is emitted on any of these paths. `Text.js` measures word widths with `props.style`, so a `fontFamily` attribute in `tick` props reaches the rendered `text` node (via `svgPropertiesNoEventsFromUnknown(tick)` in `Ticks`) but never any `getStringSize` call, as the page says.
- **(a) vs `ChartImpl.tsx` on `origin/main`.** `packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartImpl.tsx` is byte-identical between the PR's merge-base `0651e7ab41d526841f108690d266b054e602b73b` and today's `origin/main` `462bafb9ed7aca028ae4812bdb11d81efdf7880a`. `YAxis` tick props are `{ fill, fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'monospace' }` with no `interval` and default orientation (`left`); `XAxis` sets `interval={0}` and monospace in both tick branches (`AngledTick` and the object). `bar-chart` maps to `ChartBarRenderer` in `src/index.tsx`, which renders `LazyChart`, the `React.lazy` wrapper around the dynamic import of `./ChartImpl` in `src/ChartRenderer.tsx`. "This package has one instance of it" holds: `git grep fontFamily` over `packages/plugin-charts/src` hits only `ChartImpl.tsx`; `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` sets no tick font.
- **(a) Sentences that are overstated (none false):** (1) "measuring every label" — `isVisible` in `TickUtils.js` rejects a tick on position alone before calling `getSize()`, so labels already inside a claimed span are not measured; the equidistant variants measure only the ticks they visit. Accurate reading: it measures the labels it considers. Minor. (2) The opening paragraph's "labels overlap when the page font is narrower ... dropped ... when it is wider" is stated unconditionally, which is right for width-measured (top/bottom) axes; for a vertical axis the measured dimension is height and the effect is the conditional one the last paragraph states. The section corrects itself within ten lines, so this is a wording note, not an error.
- **(b) Height/width refinement.** Correct per `getTicks.js`: `sizeKey = orientation === 'top' || orientation === 'bottom' ? 'width' : 'height'`, and `getTickSize` returns `getStringSize(value, {fontSize, letterSpacing})[sizeKey]` for the height case; `implicitYAxis.orientation` is `left`, so `ChartImpl`'s y-axis is height-measured. The `line-height: normal` statement is accurate and, although the PR body grounds it in a Chromium probe, it needs no browser hedge: an absolutely positioned `span` is blockified, its single line box (`white-space: pre`, numeric labels) has the inherited `line-height` as its height whenever that value is not `normal` (inline-box height equals `line-height` in the CSS inline layout model), and only `normal` derives the height from the font's own metrics. The page says "inherits from `body`", which is the immediate parent; in this repo's console `apps/console/src/index.css` opens with `@import 'tailwindcss'`, whose preflight sets a numeric `line-height`, consistent with the PR body's "inert in such hosts" note (which the page itself does not make host-specific). Ruling A: the page still states the precondition in general terms, still names the in-repo instance by content (`ChartImpl`, `bar-chart`, `fontFamily: 'monospace'`, no `interval`, `preserveEnd`, measured in the body font), and adds the condition under which that instance changes the kept label set. That is a precision gain over the ruling's "glyph widths" wording, grounded in the source; it narrows the stated impact of the instance, not the deliverable. Judged: satisfies ruling A as ratified, no quiet narrowing.
- **(c) No forbidden workaround.** The "To meet it" paragraph tells the host to set its font stack on `body` and not to give the chart or any ancestor a different `font-family` — host CSS, not an inline style in this repo. No `tick.style.fontFamily`, no `style={{}}`, no code example of any kind (the diff adds zero fenced blocks). The word "fix" appears once, as "The fix belongs in Recharts itself", which is the ruling's position.
- **(d) Docs conventions.** No version literal in the added lines (only `interval={0}` and `0`, which the ratchet's `VERSION` regex refuses as bare integers by design; `content/docs` is in its `SCAN_ROOTS`). No `path:line` citation — `getTicks`, `ChartImpl`, `preserveEnd` and the class names are content anchors. One link added, `https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9430`, which answers 200 (issue open, labels `bug`, `pm:dispatched`, `priority:p3`, `domain:ui`); it is not in `lychee.toml`'s exclude list, so CI's link check will exercise it. The tracker statement is honest: the page says the fix "is tracked in objectui#9430" and claims no upstream issue; the card body carries no `recharts/recharts` link, and the PR body says the upstream half is not in this PR. (I could not query `recharts/recharts` from this session, 403 repo-not-enabled, so the absence of an upstream issue rests on the card and PR text, which are consistent with each other.)

### ② Semver level

None owed — no changeset, and correctly so. `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` guards only paths under `PACKAGE_ROOTS = ['packages', 'apps']` that `isPublishedSource` accepts (`src/`, `index.html`, or the manifest's `files` list); `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx` lives at the repository root under `content/`, which is no workspace package (`pnpm-workspace.yaml` lists `packages/*`, `examples/*`, `apps/*`, `docs`; `content/` has no `package.json`; `docs/` has none either). The only consumer is `apps/site` (`source.config.ts`: `defineDocs({ dir: '../../content/docs' })`), whose manifest is `"private": true` and whose name `@object-ui/site` is in `.changeset/config.json` `ignore`; AGENTS.md's release section says the same (`@object-ui/site` does not move with the fixed group). `git diff --name-status origin/main...HEAD` shows exactly one `M` and no `.changeset/*.md`, so nothing can declare `major`.

- PR body opens `Part of #9430` and `Clause-②: no`. Scanned title, body and both commit messages for closing keywords followed by an issue reference: none. The only bare keyword hit is "`pnpm-lock.yaml` resolves it to", prose, no reference.
- No model family or model version token in the title, the body, or either commit message; the two commits carry only a `Co-authored-by` trailer with the assistant's generic product name (no family or version suffix) and a session-URL trailer. The PR body's footer names the tool, not a model.
- File surface: `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx` only (+10/−0), two commits on top of merge-base `0651e7ab41d526841f108690d266b054e602b73b`, both `docs(plugin-charts):` scoped. `packages/plugin-charts/README.md` untouched, correctly — its only axis mentions are the `dataKey`/`xAxisKey` rows.
